build_residual_block: build a ResidualBlock with configurable batch norm and residual connections for a CNN model
create_global_average_pool: create a GlobalAveragePool layer to collapse spatial dimensions of a feature tensor
create_flatten_layer: create a Flatten layer to reshape a tensor into a 2D batch by features matrix
test_residual_block_forward: test the ResidualBlock forward pass with a sample input tensor and verify output shape
refactor_residual_block_batchnorm: refactor the ResidualBlock to toggle batch normalization on or off via the with_batchnorm flag
